  "pros": [
    "The to-do section helps effectively manage and track research tasks.",
    "It is easy to get started with and use, even for new team members.",
    "Facilitates clear communication and collaboration on clinical projects."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Difficulty seeing the real-time progress of multiple projects at a glance.",
    "The main page can become challenging to navigate when managing numerous studies.",
    "Lacks advanced reporting features for detailed project oversight."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "The Clinical Research Coordinator likely found Basecamp to be a straightforward tool for managing and tracking their daily tasks and project statuses, appreciating its ease of use. While it provided good core functionality for collaboration and task organization, they may have encountered limitations with real-time project progress visibility and overall navigation when handling multiple research projects within a larger organization."
